remarks: Here's your chance to live in one of Westport's most connected and desirable locations. Tucked away on a quiet property with a peaceful backyard, this beautifully refreshed 3-bedroom ranch offers the kind of location, space, and flexibility that is increasingly hard to find.  Inside, natural light fills a comfortable and surprisingly spacious layout featuring hardwood floors, central air, generous living and dining areas, and a separate family room. Three full bathrooms have been newly renovated, while the primary suite stands out with its vaulted ceiling, walk-in closet, and private bath.  Freshly painted and ready to go, the home offers an easy, move-in-ready lifestyle with room to settle in, entertain, work from home, and enjoy everything Westport has to offer. Leave the car behind and walk or bike to the train station, restaurants, shops, coffee, and everyday conveniences of Saugatuck. When it's time to unwind, step onto the private deck and take in the quiet backyard setting.  Great location. Fresh updates. Flexible living space. Private outdoor space. And Saugatuck right outside your door.  A terrific opportunity to make Westport your home.  Available NOW through 6/30, 7/31 or 8/31. Inquire with lisiting agent about lease length.
